Name: Song of Inspiration
Description: A pleasing melody follows you for the spell’s duration, protecting those around you from despair. All friendly creatures within 30 feet of you that can hear the song cannot have disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks, or saving throws. If any effect or condition would give them disadvantage, however, they cannot gain advantage on that roll either.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 3rd level or higher, the spell affects creatures within an additional 10 feet for each level slot above 2nd. If cast using a spell slot of 5th level or higher, creatures affected by this spell can gain advantage even if they would have had disadvantage on their rolls.
Sourcebook: Lyres Guide to Retia - Land of Industry
